specs.Mounting Hardware: 1x Wireless HDMI Transmitter 1x Receiver 1x HDMI Cable 2x Type-c cables 1x Manual 1x Packing Box

features: ONE TRANSMITTER, ONE RECEIVER - YOUR SCREEN ON THE BIG DISPLAY — Plug the transmitter into the HDMI port of your laptop, PC, console or camera. Plug the receiver into your TV, monitor or projector. Your screen and its sound appear on the big display. No HDMI cable has to run across the room or through a wall. This is the basic kit, for one computer and one screen.

4K PICTURE AND SOUND, 2.4GHZ AND 5GHZ DUAL BAND — Video and audio travel together on both bands A built-in chip stops interference, so the picture stays steady. 1080p and 720p also work. Range is up to 50 metres, that is 165 feet, when there is nothing in between. Through one wall you get about 10 to 30 metres. Every wireless HDMI product works this way.

HDMI AND VGA OUTPUT ON THE RECEIVER — The receiver has an HDMI port, a VGA port and a 3.5 mm audio jack. The VGA port is useful in India, because most projectors and old monitors in schools, offices and halls still take only VGA. So you can connect a new TV or an old projector without buying any converter. The 3.5 mm jack lets you take the sound to a speaker if the display sound is low.

WIDE COMPATIBILITY - SEND FROM ALMOST ANYTHING — You can send from a laptop, desktop PC, Mac, PS3, PS4, PS5, Nintendo Switch, camera, DV camcorder, set-top box or Android TV box - all through their HDMI port. A phone or tablet can cast straight to the receiver, no transmitter needed. You can send to any TV, monitor or projector, using HDMI or VGA.

COPY MODE OR EXTENDED MODE — In Copy mode the big screen shows the same thing as your laptop. This is what you want for a presentation or a film. In Extended mode the laptop and the big screen show different things, so you can keep your notes on the laptop and show only the slides to the room. You choose the mode in your computer display settings.

ADD MORE COMPUTERS WHENEVER YOU NEED — One receiver can be paired with up to 8 transmitters, and one click switches between them. They do not disturb each other. So this kit can grow: buy extra transmitters later, and every new laptop keeps its own. Extra transmitters are sold separately.

WHAT YOU GET IN THE BOX — 1 receiver, one transmitter, 1 HDMI cable, 2 USB power cables, 1 reset pin and 1 user manual. Please give each unit power from a 5V 2A adapter, not from the USB port of your TV. TV USB ports often give less power, and low power is the most common reason the picture goes off. Warranty is 6 months against manufacturing defects.
